name: Caves of the Damned
description: Caves under Halcyon where the Untouchables were banished, later turned into sterile laboratories and the site of the portal to Phyrexia.

description_citations.text: "The Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gix, a human rebel of the Caves of the Damned, ambushes Glacian and stabs him with a powerstone shard, infecting him with phthisis.
timeline.quote: He stabbed Glacian with a powerstone shard

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth cures phthisis and coerces an oath of loyalty from Gix, pacifying his rebellion.
timeline.quote: vowed to serve Yawgmoth faithfully forever

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Brothers' War a demon enters Dominaria, takes over the monks' dreams, and announces himself as Gix at Koilos.
timeline.quote: then announced himself as that very same Gix.

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth sends infected people into the Caves and brings healthy ones to the city, using this to eliminate enemies.
timeline.quote: is using this to eliminate his enemies from the city.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 2: The Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed opens a permanent portal to an artificial world, which Yawgmoth names Phyrexia and binds himself to, becoming a god.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth binds himself to the plane, becoming a god while staying there.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 3: The World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebbec reunites the powerstone, hears Glacian's voice, and places it on the pedestal to close the portal, locking Yawgmoth out of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She goes to the pedestal room and does that, even though Yawgmoth pleads her not to from the other side of the portal.

citation.text: "The Thran", section "Part 4: The Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza destroys the sleeper agents of Gulmany, and Gix flees to Koilos for a final battle with Urza.
timeline.quote: Urza followed him there, and Gix engaged him in a climactic final battle.

citation.text: "Gix", section "Final incursion and downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves to disrupt Gix's temporal shift, which implodes on him and annihilates him.
timeline.quote: causing it to implode upon Gix in a blinding inferno and annihilate him at last.

citation.text: "Gix", section "Final incursion and downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Prisoners in the penal colony overthrow their counselors and take over the caves; Halcyon's guard fails to reclaim them and the city seals off all but one entry.
timeline.quote: They banded together, overthrew their counselors and facilitators, and took over the caves.

citation.text: "Caves of the Damned", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth transports more infected from Halcyon to the caves while Gix arranges escapes.
timeline.quote: Gix arranged for several escapes through secret passages

citation.text: "Caves of the Damned", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dyfed builds a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia in the caves.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia

citation.text: "Caves of the Damned", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the end of the Thran Civil War Yawgmoth ushers the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth ushered the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia

citation.text: "Caves of the Damned", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After 5,000 years Urza, Mishra and Tocasia rediscover the caves, and Urza renames them Koilos.
timeline.quote: They then received the new name " Koilos " from Urza.

citation.text: "Caves of the Damned", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth, in love with Rebbec, banishes Glacian to the Caves of the Damned and secretly replaces the stone sliver with the two halves of Dyfed's powerstone; the radiation kills Glacian.
timeline.quote: The radiation of these stones killed him, but his essence was trapped inside them

citation.text: "Glacian", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
